name: Merret
description: A low-skilled covert agent of House Dimir working the Ravnican docks, husband of Tashi and father of Soche and a baby, who drinks stolen Elixir of Focus and is drawn into Lazav's plans for his son.

timeline.summary: Merret, working the docks as a Dimir agent, nearly pockets a bottle of expensive whiskey from a crate before his boss approaches and he hides it.
Grimbly Wothis orders Merret to clear the fog from the harbor for an investor, threatening to dock his pay.
timeline.quote: How's this for confidence . . . you don't clear it and you don't get your pay for today?

timeline.summary: Merret barely thins the fog and reveals a Simic schooner cloaking itself, which Wothis uses as a selling point to the investor.
timeline.quote: Fog swirls, barely, clearing about halfway to the other side of the river

timeline.summary: Merret returns to his cramped home in Keyhole Village, where Tashi demands he find real food for the hungry baby.
timeline.quote: Get the food, Merret. I don't care how.

timeline.summary: Failing to steal from a posh grocer, Merret breaks into Grimbly Wothis's apartment through an unlocked window.
timeline.quote: I round the building, make a quick hop to the balcony, and sure enough, find an unlocked window.

timeline.summary: Merret takes a loaf of bread and drinks drops of an Elixir of Focus from Wothis's kitchen.
timeline.quote: Just one more, for good measure.

timeline.summary: Wothis's wife enters the kitchen, and the elixir sharpens Merret's magic enough to make himself invisible to her.
timeline.quote: I draw on magic, and her mind opens up to me like a map.

timeline.summary: Empowered, Merret clears the whole harbor, then in a show-off moment casts a nightmare on the crane operator Yantis, dropping a crate of whiskey toward Wothis and the investor.
timeline.quote: Yantis screams, fighting all the terrifying nothings in front of him.

timeline.summary: Wothis shoves the investor into the river and jumps in as the crate smashes; Merret fears House Dimir will erase him.
timeline.quote: Nope, there's nothing covert about ruining a thousand zinos worth of cargo.

timeline.summary: Merret's baby, healthy after gnawing elixir-stained bread, sneezes and every candle in the apartment ignites.
timeline.quote: Then baby sneezes, and every single candle in our apartment bursts into flame.

timeline.summary: Wothis breaks into the apartment, beats Merret and demands the child, saying he saw the candle trick through the window.
timeline.quote: I saw what that child did through the window, the trick with the candles.

timeline.summary: Merret weaves a nightmare in Wothis's mind but loses focus when Wothis nears Soche, and Wothis seizes the baby.
timeline.quote: And like that, my baby is in Grimbly Wothis's arms

timeline.summary: Wothis kicks Merret in the mouth and throws Tashi into a cabinet, breaking her ribs.
timeline.quote: With a hard shake, he flings her off.

timeline.summary: Merret notices Lazav sitting in the armchair, and the baby takes his first steps into Lazav's arms.
timeline.quote: Could this be Lazav? Lazav the Mastermind, Guildmaster of House Dimir?

timeline.summary: Lazav offers to pay Merret's debts, give a stipend, and send a tutor to teach the gifted baby, who stays with the family.
timeline.quote: we would like to ask that we send a tutor to your home to oversee his learning

timeline.summary: Lazav's laugh scrambles the family's memories so that Great Aunt Bea seems to be staying with them.
timeline.quote: Lazav laughs a raspy laugh, like stones scratching against rib bone.

relations.note: Wothis beats Merret and tries to take his son.
relations.quote: A child like this is worth something
